_note: Batch 14: ten REAL Perth retreat and day-escape providers researched from public information on 10 Aug 2026. Deepens the existing 'retreats' category (3 listings before this batch). Original blurbs, all unclaimed, no copied ratings. Copy describes formats, settings and durations only — several of these businesses market condition-themed programs (weight loss, detox, cancer wellness); those framings are deliberately NOT repeated, per the no-therapeutic-claims rule. Prices are the lowest published figure where one exists, else null. New suburbs introduced: Pickering Brook and Mount Helena (Perth Hills), Henley Brook, Upper Swan and Chittering (Swan Valley & East). Honest gaps: Shalem (Manjimup) and Origins Centre (Balingup) were researched and excluded as beyond day-trip range; VitalityFit's site was unreachable and is not included.

categories.name: Retreats & day escapes
categories.blurb: Half-day resets through to weekend retreats within a drive of Perth.

listings.name: Hidden Valley Eco Lodges & Day Spa
listings.blurb: An adults-only retreat set in its own jarrah forest in the Perth Hills, about half an hour from the city. Self-contained lodges each have a kitchen, log fire and outdoor heated jacuzzi, and the on-site day spa — massage, facials, rituals and wraps, pregnancy pampering — takes casual day visitors as well as lodge guests, Monday to Saturday. In-lodge dining, platters and picnic hampers round out a stay.
listings._source: hiddenvalleyeco.com.au — address, adults-only policy, lodge features, day spa menu and Mon–Sat hours, day-visitor access, phone and email all published; treatment prices not shown on the main page

listings.name: Amaroo Retreat & Spa
listings.blurb: Eight luxury chalets tucked into Perth Hills bushland at Mount Helena, each with a private spa on its deck. The day spa offers massage and facial treatments, and The Lounge restaurant and bar keeps a stay self-contained — breakfast hampers arrive at the chalet door. Accommodation is strictly adults-only; stays start from $495 a night.
listings._source: amarooretreat.com.au — address, eight chalets, private deck spas, day spa, restaurant, 18+ accommodation policy, from-$495 nightly rate, phone and email all published

listings.name: Natures Paradise Health Retreat
listings.blurb: A small, purpose-built adults-only retreat on a secluded hilltop outside Mundaring, surrounded by state forest and national park, running residential programs since 2013. Themed retreats span day visits through to multi-day stays — yoga, forest walks, mindfulness and spa-focused formats — with a swim pond, gym, infrared sauna, mineral baths and a library on the property. Airport pick-up is complimentary for retreat guests.
listings._source: naturesparadise.com.au — Mundaring hilltop location, adults-only, operating since 2013, retreat formats, facilities, airport pick-up, phone and email published; street address and package prices not shown. Their condition-themed retreat names (weight loss, detox, cancer wellness) deliberately not repeated in our copy

listings.name: Swan Valley Retreat
listings.blurb: A day spa and small overnight retreat in the Swan Valley with an unusually broad wellness menu: massage, facials, clay treatments, hydrotherapy and floatation therapy, plus The Oasis — sauna, ice bath and spa sessions. Day visitors are explicitly welcome, six days a week, with Oasis and float sessions running Sundays too. Three luxury rooms serve those who stay over.
listings._source: swanvalleyretreat.com.au — address, three rooms, spa/float/hydrotherapy menu, The Oasis, day-visitor policy and weekly hours, phone published; email obfuscated on page, prices on the Fresha booking system rather than the site

listings.name: Brookleigh Day Spa Health Retreats
listings.address: 1235 Great Northern Highway, Upper Swan WA
listings.blurb: Structured retreat packages in the Swan Valley, from single-day resets built around yoga, meditation and spa treatments through to multi-day residential programs. Day formats start at $395, the one-day yoga and meditation retreat runs at $525 with group rates, and longer packages extend to five days. Retreats run Monday to Friday, booked online.
listings._source: brookleighbeautyandspa.com.au — Upper Swan address via booking system, package names, day and multi-day prices ($395–$4,700), Mon–Fri availability, Fresha booking; direct phone/email not on the retreats page. Package names like 'Health Revival' kept out of our copy in favour of plain descriptions

listings.name: Wyld Tribe
listings.blurb: A Perth women's community running retreats since 2012, best known for the Wild Woman Weekend — four days and three nights of ceremony, dance, workshops and singing in bushland at the foot of the Darling Scarp in Serpentine. Facilitators Tracy McFie and Larissa O'Neill have held the weekend for thirteen years. Fully catered with vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options; $1,666 all-inclusive, alongside mentoring and smaller gatherings through the year.
listings._source: wyldtribe.com — facilitator names, 13-year history, 2012 founding, Serpentine venue, 4-day/3-night format, catering detail, $1,666 price, Sep 2026 dates and contact email all published

listings.name: Journeys of the Spirit
listings.blurb: Julie Baker and Emma McLarty run small-group wellness journeys from Perth, with their signature Rejuvenation Retreat held on an 1,800-acre property in the Chittering Valley surrounded by state forest above the Avon River. The long-weekend format pairs private cabins and all meals with guided bush walks and unhurried days built around rest. The pair also lead international journeys — Kerala, Bhutan, Japan among them — and arrange private group retreats.
listings._source: journeysofthespirit.com.au — facilitator names, Chittering Valley 1,800-acre venue, cabin/meals/bush-walk inclusions, Sep 2026 dates, phone and email published; prices held in a brochure PDF rather than the page

listings.name: Spanda School Retreats
listings.blurb: Fremantle's Spanda School runs structured silent retreats built on non-dual meditation, gentle movement and rest — one-day sittings at the school itself, and three- and seven-day residentials at Donnelly Lakes near Pemberton. Two formats serve different depths of practice: a guided version for those newer to silence, and longer unguided sits for experienced meditators. Around a hundred students come through each year, some from interstate and overseas.
listings._source: spandaschool.com — Fremantle base, Donnelly Lakes venue, 1/3/7-day formats, two practice streams, ~100 students yearly, phone published; per-retreat prices sit on individual booking pages

listings.name: WildFlower Yoga Collective
listings.blurb: Holly Dutton teaches yoga at City Beach and runs residential retreats in WA's south-west — most recently a four-day Margaret River weekend combining daily yoga, sauna and ice bath sessions, breathwork, meditation, bush walks and a cacao ceremony, fully catered. Shared and single rooms from $1,495. Private retreats for groups of six or more can be arranged at Rottnest, Yallingup, Ferguson Valley and the Swan Valley.
listings._source: wildfloweryogacollective.net — facilitator name and background, City Beach classes, Margaret River retreat inclusions and $1,495–$1,990 pricing, private retreat minimum and locations, email published

listings.name: BODHI J Wellness Spa Retreat
listings.blurb: A long-standing Wembley day spa built around multi-hour 'spa journey' packages — massage, facials, body therapies and healing treatments using organic Sodashi and Li'tya products, with sauna and light-therapy rooms on site. A team of around forty therapists runs six days a week, with late Thursday evenings. Pregnancy-safe rituals and men's treatments sit alongside the classic day-escape packages.
listings._source: bodhispa.com (403 to fetch; cross-checked via bestwellness.com.au listing and public directory pages) — Grantham St address, hours incl. late Thursday, treatment menu, ~40 therapists, organic product lines, phone published; package prices not captured
